$comment: Advisories npm audit may report while no fixed version exists (tools/npm_audit.py, decision 0015). Each entry: the GHSA id, the package, why it's accepted, until when (90 days at most), and the package's newest version when it was accepted (`latest`): a newer release fails the check until someone looks. Remove an entry the moment a fix ships.

allow.why: ReDoS from an attacker-written extglob pattern, in every picomatch to 4.0.7, the latest; no fixed version on 2026-11-17. It reaches only the build and test tools (vite, vitest, typescript-eslint; npm ls --omit=dev lists none), whose globs are the project's own.
